bugs.title: Client item-type flag bypassed stock issuance
bugs.fix: Determine inventory behavior from the canonical product and lock stock rows.

bugs.title: Negative/zero quantities and negative money were accepted
bugs.fix: Validate positive, storable quantity precision and nonnegative finite line amounts.

bugs.title: POS trusted client totals/tax and lost bill discounts
bugs.fix: Reuse commercial decimal normalization, allocate bill discounts and snapshot canonical item tax.

bugs.title: Non-restocked refunds did not consume refundable quantity
bugs.fix: Count every return and serialize competing refunds.

bugs.title: Return could substitute a different inventory product
bugs.fix: Bind returns to the original sale line and validate warehouse scope.

bugs.title: Refund lost original discounts/tax and allowed over-refund
bugs.fix: Use remaining original value/tax, proportional refunds and last-return rounding remainder.

bugs.title: PostgreSQL contact retention query compared text IDs to integers
bugs.fix: Bind identifiers using their stored SQL type; retain linked history.

bugs.title: FAM GST ties rounded differently from commercial/POS arithmetic
bugs.fix: Apply explicit ROUND_HALF_UP to each tax component.

bugs.title: GST API accepted negative and invalid component rates
bugs.fix: Validate GST component bounds and nonnegative taxable/cess values; preserve configurable positive cess.

bugs.title: 100-customer page performed 405 SELECTs
bugs.fix: Batch details, relationships and branch availability for the authorized page only.

bugs.title: FAM table adapter swallowed the financial empty state
bugs.fix: Render explicit empty status and suppress stale statements on failed requests.

bugs.title: Successful bank-rule creation left its dialog open
bugs.fix: Close on an explicit successful creation revision; retain forms on errors.

bugs.title: Navigation/accounting harnesses had stale dependencies, server assumptions and races
bugs.fix: Load real route helpers, honor current workspace presentation, start isolated servers and await confirmed requests.

bugs.title: POS order/return accepted foreign or replacement customer IDs
bugs.fix: Reuse tenant-scoped commercial customer/contact resolvers and bind return customer to its source sale.

bugs.title: Workflow interpretation intercepted pending single-action help/cancellation
bugs.fix: Preserve ownership of pending single-action slot filling and cancellation.

bugs.title: Nested provider/worker retries made nine requests for a three-attempt job
bugs.fix: Worker owns retries through a context-local one-attempt provider budget; synchronous retries retain their bounded contract.

bugs.title: POS rounded payable to whole currency units and displayed a local rather than confirmed total
bugs.fix: Keep cents in the preview and display the persisted server total after checkout.

bugs.title: Checkpoint snapshots mistook a successful own update for a stale plan
bugs.fix: Reload persisted task state before computing the next checkpoint digest; retain checks against actual external edits.

bugs.title: Single-asset assignment passed null into the handover condition contract
bugs.fix: Use the existing Good default when the optional legacy condition is omitted.

bugs.title: Contact imports normalized calling codes only when a phone was present
bugs.fix: Normalize an explicitly supplied calling code independently of the optional phone value.

bugs.title: LWP feed repeated period/group/policy queries for every employee
bugs.fix: Batch group selection and cache the period and effective policy per group, retaining policy calculations.

bugs.title: PostgreSQL schema verification manifest lagged existing migrations
bugs.fix: Update the verification manifest for migration-backed tables and columns; preserve the historical baseline and do not change application schema.

bugs.title: Legacy fixtures bypassed current identity, inspection and serialization contracts
bugs.fix: Exercise a real canonical customer, required inspection approvals, normalized dependency fields, explicit-rule precedence and structural weight privacy; retain all authorization controls.

bugs.title: Rate-limit integration tests depended on remaining in one wall-clock minute
bugs.fix: QA counters recorded six attempts in one minute and three in the next (business-suite-rate-window-evidence.json). Pin only the limiter clock in the fixture; retain production fixed-window behavior and explicit rollover/deadline tests.

bugs.title: Assistant presentation tool omitted its structured-slide input contract
bugs.fix: Describe the existing bounded slide schema and required empty text/table fields; preserve review-before-save behavior.

bugs.title: Finance analytics fixture used the host date for an explicitly UTC organization
bugs.fix: Date synthetic vouchers using UTC, matching the fixture company; retain organization-timezone filtering.

bugs.title: PMS analytics mixed organization business days with UTC date/hour buckets
bugs.fix: Use organization-zone range boundaries, local daily/hourly buckets, server-default dates and matching UI labels/exports. Verify midnight and a 25-hour DST day.
